concerns.text: FR-001 mandates 'download ... from the Zenodo URL' and FR-017 'an external validation dataset from a separate Zenodo release'; T001/T008 substitute Materials Project API queries. The plan authorizes MP, but the spec was never amended — the tasks silently relax two MUST-level source constraints. Either amend the spec (blank placeholder URLs) or add a task-level note that this is a spec-level decision requiring ratification, not a task-level substitution.

T008 writes external metrics as 'R², |r|, p-value' to data/results/external_metrics.json but claims validation against contracts/metrics.schema.yaml, which REQUIRES r2_ci and pearson_r_ci (bootstrap CIs). As specified, the deliverable cannot validate against the contract it names — either compute bootstrap CIs on the external set or validate against a contract whose required fields match the deliverable.

concerns.text: Acceptance Scenario 1 ('Given a valid CSV file containing alloy compositions ... run the pipeline with default settings') and the hea_composition.schema.yaml contract have no implementing task — every task ingests data only via the MP API. Half of FR-009's user-facing input path is dropped without spec amendment.

FR-021 says 'ensure the maximum rank difference across runs is ≤ 1' and plan Phase 10 says 'abort if > 1'; T009 instead records 'the honest failure' and continues. Not threshold-weakening, but the failure behavior contradicts both spec and plan — pick one behavior and align all three artifacts.

T004 and the coverage table map FR-023 to the power-analysis abort; FR-023 is actually the measurement-protocol/confound documentation requirement (covered by T008). FR-023 is not dropped, but the traceability mapping is wrong and will mislead SC verification in T013.
